description: Compares two 8-bit binary numbers built from gate inputs, with six outputs for the possible results

params.text: Sets that bit of the B value to one when lit and zero when unlit; patching a cable into the B input for that bit takes the button out of use

inputs.text: One bit of the A value; over 2V counts as a one, and an unpatched A input counts as a zero. A0 is the least significant bit and A7 the most significant
One bit of the B value; over 2V counts as a one. Patching a cable here takes the button for that bit out of use, leaving only the patched level

outputs.text: 10V while the A value is less than the B value, 0V otherwise
10V while the A value is less than or equal to the B value, 0V otherwise
10V while the two values are equal, 0V otherwise
10V while the A value is greater than or equal to the B value, 0V otherwise
10V while the A value is greater than the B value, 0V otherwise
10V while the two values differ, 0V while they are equal
